canonical_statement: For every integer degree p on a smooth compact oriented Riemannian manifold without boundary, every real de Rham cohomology class has a unique harmonic p-form representative.
domain_and_universes: A finite-dimensional smooth manifold M with a Riemannian metric and orientation; p : Nat; real differential forms and real de Rham cohomology. Exact Lean universes and model are not frozen.
conclusion: There exists a unique smooth p-form omega with HodgeLaplacian omega = 0 and cohomologyClass omega = c.

alternate_encodings.target: Harmonic^p(M) -> H^p_dR(M; Real) is an isomorphism

alternate_encodings.relationship: strong analytic formulation implying the root

excluded_degenerate_cases: Manifolds with boundary, noncompact manifolds, singular spaces, twisted coefficients, and complex/Kahler refinements are outside this root. Degrees above dimension may be boundary probes but are not removed from the quantified claim.
